title: Leaders See Geospatial Science as Key to Future of St. Louis
summary_en: Saint Louis University President Edward Feser, Ph.D., hopes the future of geospatial science involves SLU graduates. Feser shared his thoughts on the future of geospatial science and what it means for the city of St. Louis as part of the Leader's Look panel discussion at the 2026 Geo-Resolution conference. title_cn: Leaders See Geospatial Science as Key to Future of St. Louis

title: SLU/YouGov Poll: Amendment 3 Falls to a Dead Heat While Missourians Back Protections for the Initiative Petition Process by a 27-Point Margin
summary_en: The August 2026 SLU/YouGov Poll surveyed 900 likely Missouri voters about their opinions regarding the 2026 election, ballot initiatives and amendments, data centers, and matters considered by the Missouri state government.
title_cn: SLU/YouGov Poll: Amendment 3 Falls to a Dead Heat While Missourians Back Protections for the Initiative Petition Process by a 27-Point Margin
